post.originalText:
I'm not a motion designer. I gave Opus 5.5 one idea: introduce yourself with a short video.

It built the 3D scene, the particles, the text animation and the final title on its own. It took 20 minutes.

A year ago this would have meant a freelancer and a few days of work. https://t.co/hXlTmrkhHA
